title: Network MS Engineers - Senior
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**As a Network Security Operations Engineer** 
 , you will be responsible for providing operational security support across network environments, analysing security incidents and risks, and implementing protective controls to ensure the availability, integrity, and security of client networks.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Provide ongoing operational support and management of network environments, ensuring high availability, stability, and adherence to agreed service levels.
* Work closely with clients to understand operational requirements, business priorities, and network support needs, ensuring services align with day‑to‑day business operations.
* Perform regular health checks, audits, and operational reviews of network infrastructure to identify risks, incidents, and opportunities for improvement.
* Support and maintain network configurations, documentation, and operational runbooks, ensuring accuracy and readiness for operational and incident scenarios.
* Lead and participate in incident management, problem resolution, and root cause analysis for complex network issues, ensuring timely restoration and prevention of recurrence.
* Conduct network performance monitoring, capacity management, and utilization analysis to proactively address performance bottlenecks and scalability needs.
* Support change management activities, including validation, implementation, and post‑change monitoring, ensuring minimal business disruption.
* Collaborate with cross‑functional operational teams (service desk, system administrators, security, and application teams) to deliver integrated and coordinated support.
* Apply operational best practices, standards, and compliance requirements to ensure process consistency and operational governance.
* Stay current with modern network technologies and operational trends, recommending improvements that enhance reliability, resilience, and operational efficiency.
* Provide day‑to‑day guidance and mentoring to junior engineers, supporting skill development, operational maturity, and knowledge transfer within the team.


**Requirements:**
* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 6\-9 years of experience in network consulting, design, and implementation, preferably in a client\-facing role.
* Strong hands‑on experience with FireMon, Check Point firewalls, and Zscaler platforms in a network security operations environment.
* Proficient in network protocols and technologies such as TCP/IP, DNS, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VLANs, VPNs, and firewalls.
* Strong expertise in modern network technologies, including but not limited to SD\-WAN, virtualization, cloud networking, software\-defined networking (SDN), and network automation.
* Hands\-on experience with network equipment from leading vendors, such as Cisco, Juniper, Arista, etc.
* Expertise on Ansible for seamless automation of IP network configurations, optimizing the deployment and management of networking infrastructure.
* Expertise on Terraform to define and provision IP network resources, ensuring consistent and scalable network architectures.
* Proficient in cloud networking technologies and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE).
* Familiarity with network monitoring and management tools, such as Wireshark, SolarWinds, or Nagios.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex network requirements and propose effective solutions.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of effectively presenting technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Industry certifications from vendors like Cisco, Juniper, Zscaler, Palo Alto, Fortinet etc. are highly desirable.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Networking Managed Services Engineer (L1)
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
 Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
   

  

**Your day at NTT DATA**
 As a Networking Managed Services Engineer (L1\) at NTT DATA, you'll step into an entry\-level role where your primary focus will be providing managed services to ensure our clients' IT infrastructure and systems remain operational. Your day will involve proactively identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems to support our clients effectively.
   

  

 You'll monitor client infrastructure and solutions, catching errors before or as soon as they occur. Your role will involve investigating first\-line incidents, understanding their root causes, and following approved procedures for request fulfilment. Whether it's providing telephonic, ITSM ticket or chat support, executing maintenance activities like patching and configuration changes, or ensuring smooth shift handovers for continuous service, your efforts are all about maintaining high standards of service quality.
   

  

 You'll also identify opportunities for optimization, whether it's reducing common incidents or finding automation possibilities for request fulfilment, incident resolution, and process improvements. Your role may occasionally extend to supporting project work and disaster recovery functions and tests, contributing to our broader goals and ensuring we're always ahead of the curve.
   

  

 Throughout your journey with us, you'll ensure that incidents and requests are resolved efficiently and comprehensively, escalating when necessary. You'll also help update existing knowledge or to share valuable insights, ensuring we continuously learn and improve.
   

  

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**
* Basic understanding in technologies such as Pulse Secure SSL VPN, Virtual Juniper, Palo Alto, Fortinet Firewalls, Cisco Nexus switches, ASr and ISr routers, Cisco ACS, ISE, Meraki switches, and common routing protocols like BGP, OSPF, and EIGrP.

* Adaptability to changing environments.
* A client\-focused approach, creating positive client experiences throughout their journey.

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**
**Blue Dart Express Limited** 
 , a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
   

  

 We are proud to be consistently ranked among
 **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work** 
 , combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an
 **Employer of Choice** 
 is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
   

  

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety,
 **Blue Dart is where you belong** 
 . Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
   

  

**Position Overview:**
 The Executive / Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – IT is responsible for ensuring the availability, stability and day\-to\-day support of IT infrastructure and end\-user systems across operational and administrative locations within the assigned region. The role coordinates IT support activities, manages vendor service delivery, resolves infrastructure issues and ensures minimal disruption to business operations.
   

  

 Working closely with Operations, Customer Service, Commercial, HR and Corporate IT teams, the role provides first and second\-level support for IT infrastructure, end\-user computing, hardware, software and network\-related issues while ensuring adherence to service levels, IT standards and information security requirements.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To provide reliable, responsive and efficient IT support across the assigned region by ensuring timely resolution of technology issues, effective vendor coordination, high system availability and uninterrupted business operations through proactive infrastructure support and adherence to IT governance standards.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**
**Regional IT Operations Support**
* Provide day\-to\-day IT support across all operational and administrative locations within the assigned region, ensuring high system availability and minimal business disruption.
* Coordinate resolution of hardware, software, network and system\-related issues impacting business operations.
* Ensure operational locations receive timely IT support in accordance with defined service levels.
* Provide on\-site support for critical IT issues where remote resolution is not feasible.
* Support regional IT readiness for new branch openings, relocations, expansions and operational infrastructure changes.


**Incident \& Service Request Management**
* Manage IT incidents and service requests from logging through resolution, ensuring adherence to defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Prioritise and coordinate resolution of business\-critical incidents impacting operational continuity.
* Perform first\-level troubleshooting and coordinate with specialised support teams for second and third\-level issues.
* Track recurring incidents, identify root causes and recommend preventive actions.
* Maintain accurate incident documentation, escalation records and service request updates.


**End User Computing \& Infrastructure Support**
* Support end\-user devices including desktops, laptops, printers, handheld devices, scanners and other operational IT equipment.
* Coordinate installation, configuration and maintenance of approved hardware, software and peripheral devices.
* Ensure timely provisioning and replacement of IT equipment for employees and operational locations.
* Support connectivity, user access, system availability and peripheral device functionality across the region.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance activities to maximise infrastructure reliability and equipment uptime.


**Vendor Management \& Service Delivery**
* Coordinate and monitor regional IT support vendors to ensure timely and effective service delivery.
* Track vendor performance against agreed SLAs and escalate service gaps where required.
* Validate completion of vendor activities and ensure quality of work performed.
* Coordinate warranty repairs, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) and third\-party support activities.
* Build effective working relationships with vendor partners to ensure uninterrupted IT support across the region.


**IT Asset \& Inventory Management**
* Maintain accurate records of regional IT assets including desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, handheld devices and networking equipment.
* Coordinate asset allocation, movement, replacement and disposal in accordance with organisational policies.
* Support periodic IT asset verification and inventory audits.
* Ensure software licensing, asset tagging and documentation remain accurate and up to date.
* Monitor asset lifecycle and recommend timely replacement of ageing or obsolete equipment.


**Business Continuity \& Operational Readiness**
* Support business continuity by ensuring IT systems remain operational across all regional locations.
* Coordinate IT readiness for new operational sites, office relocations and infrastructure expansion projects.
* Participate in disaster recovery activities, system recovery testing and operational contingency planning where applicable.
* Ensure critical operational systems supporting logistics and customer service remain available with minimal downtime.
* Provide IT support during peak business periods and critical operational events to ensure uninterrupted business operations.


**Information Security \& IT Governance**
* Ensure compliance with organisational IT policies, information security standards and regulatory requirements across all regional locations.
* Support implementation of IT security controls, endpoint protection, user access management and system compliance initiatives.
* Coordinate timely installation of software updates, security patches and antivirus definitions in collaboration with Corporate IT and support vendors.
* Report IT security incidents, system vulnerabilities and policy deviations, ensuring timely corrective actions.
* Promote awareness of information security best practices among regional users.


**Cross\-functional Stakeholder Support**
* Partner with Operations, Customer Service, Commercial, Finance, HR and other business functions to understand IT support requirements and ensure timely service delivery.
* Coordinate with Corporate IT teams for system upgrades, application deployments, infrastructure enhancements and enterprise\-wide IT initiatives.
* Provide IT support for new branch openings, relocations, office expansions and operational infrastructure changes.
* Assist business users during rollout of new applications, hardware and technology solutions.
* Maintain effective communication with stakeholders regarding incident status, planned maintenance and system availability.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify recurring IT issues and recommend process improvements to enhance service quality and operational efficiency.
* Support implementation of new technologies, automation initiatives and digital solutions that improve business productivity.
* Recommend improvements to IT support processes, knowledge documentation and service delivery standards.
* Contribute to regional IT projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Foster a culture of customer service, collaboration, accountability, innovation and continuous learning.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
**Education** 
 :
   

  

  

* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics, Computer Engineering or a related discipline is mandatory.
* Relevant technical certifications such as Microsoft, Cisco, ITIL, CompTIA or equivalent will be an added advantage.


**Experience** 
 :
   

  

  

* 3–6 years of experience in IT Infrastructure Support, End User Computing, Desktop Support or Regional IT Operations.
* Experience supporting multi\-location business operations within a regional environment.
* Strong experience in hardware troubleshooting, operating systems, user support and IT infrastructure coordination.
* Experience coordinating with outsourced IT support vendors and monitoring service delivery against agreed SLAs.
* Exposure to IT asset management, incident management, user access administration and IT support processes.
* Experience supporting logistics, transportation, warehousing, manufacturing, retail or other multi\-site organisations will be preferred.


**Skills \& Capabilities:**
**Technical Skills:**
* IT Infrastructure \& End User Support
* Hardware \& Peripheral Device Support
* Windows Operating Systems \& Microsoft Office
* Basic Network Troubleshooting
* IT Incident \& Service Request Management
* IT Asset \& Inventory Management
* Vendor \& SLA Management
* Active Directory \& User Access Management (preferred)
* IT Security \& Endpoint Compliance
* Microsoft Office Suite and IT Service Management (ITSM) tools


**Key Competencies:**
* Customer Centricity
* Service Orientation
* Communication Skills
* Problem Solving \& Analytical Thinking
* Planning \& Coordination
* Stakeholder Management
* Teamwork \& Collaboration
* Accountability \& Ownership
* Adaptability \& Learning Agility
* Integrity \& Professionalism
* Continuous Improvement Mindset


**Key Performance Indicators:**
**KRAs**
**KPIs**
 IT Service Delivery
   

  

 Incident resolution within SLA, Service Request Closure TAT, System Availability
   

  

 End User Support
   

  

 User Satisfaction, First\-Time Resolution Rate, Reduction in Repeat Incidents
   

  

 Vendor Performance
   

  

 Vendor SLA Compliance, Timely Escalation \& Resolution, Quality of Service Delivery
   

  

 IT Asset Management
   

  

 Asset Accuracy, Inventory Compliance, Timely Asset Deployment \& Recovery
   

  

 Infrastructure Support
   

  

 Hardware Uptime, Preventive Maintenance Completion, Regional IT Readiness
   

  

 Information Security
   

  

 Compliance with IT Policies, Patch \& Antivirus Compliance, Security Incident Resolution
   

  

 Business Support
   

  

 IT Readiness for New Sites, Business Continuity Support, Stakeholder Satisfaction
   

  

 Continuous Improvement
   

  

 Process Improvements Implemented, Reduction in Recurring Incidents, Contribution to IT Projects

 When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose\-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.

title: Infrastructure Architect
description:
**Project Role :** 
 Infrastructure Architect
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Design and govern end\-to\-end data center infrastructure architecture across compute, storage, and networking layers, with a focus on scalable, secure, and cost\-efficient AI\-enabled environments. Define architecture standards and patterns across compute, network, and storage domains, ensuring alignment with security and compliance requirements while supporting business and operational needs.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Oracle Database Administration (DBA)
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 2 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As an Infrastructure Architect, your day involves designing and overseeing comprehensive data center infrastructure that spans computing, storage, and networking components. You focus on creating environments that are scalable, secure, and optimized for artificial intelligence applications. Your role includes establishing architectural standards and patterns that align with security protocols and compliance mandates, while ensuring the infrastructure supports both business objectives and operational efficiency. Collaboration with various teams to maintain a cohesive and robust infrastructure is a key part of your daily activities.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:

title: Tech S and T-Network Engineer Senior-GDSN02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**DevSecOps \& AI Engineer**
**Job Description**
* Build and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, and CircleCI for application, data, and AI workloads.
* Integrate DevSecOps practices into pipelines using Snyk, SonarQube, Checkmarx, Trivy, Anchore, and OWASP tools for continuous security scanning.
* Implement shift\-left security with secret scanning (GitLeaks, TruffleHog), SBOM automation (Syft, CycloneDX), and dependency management (Dependabot, Renovate).
* Work with containerization (Docker/Podman) and Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE) including Helm/Kustomize for deployments and secure image pipelines.
* Develop and automate MLOps workflows using MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML, SageMaker, or Vertex AI for model training, packaging, and deployment.
* Build and maintain RAG/AI integration pipelines using LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases like Pinecone, Weaviate, or FAISS.
* Implement AI inference systems using Seldon Core, KServe, BentoML, Ray Serve, or Triton Inference Server for scalable model serving.
* Automate ETL/ELT and data feature pipelines using Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt, or Kafka/Kinesis for AI model data feeds.
* Work with IaC tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, or Azure Bicep to provision cloud and AI infrastructure.
* Implement event\-driven architectures using serverless functions (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, Cloud Functions) and messaging systems like Kafka or RabbitMQ.
* Maintain monitoring and logging using Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Datadog, or New Relic for both app and ML workloads.
* Handle model \& data observability using tools like Evidently AI, Arize AI, WhyLabs, or Fiddler for drift, bias, and performance tracking.
* Secure cloud environments using IAM best practices (AWS IAM, Azure AD/Entra ID, GCP IAM), workload identities, and least\-privilege controls.
* Support configuration management using Ansible, Chef, or SaltStack for environment consistency and automation.
* Develop scripts in Python, Bash, or SQL for automation, data processing, validation, and orchestration of ML workflows.
* Implement API integrations for AI systems using REST, gRPC, or GraphQL for model consumption and downstream applications.
* Use GitOps tools like Argo CD or Flux for automated, secure Kubernetes deployments and progressive delivery.
* Apply AI security practices including guardrails, prompt protection, model validation, and safe inference techniques using industry tools.
* Ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, and security standards including GDPR, CCPA, and cloud security best practices.
* Collaborate with data engineers, ML engineers, DevOps teams, and security teams, contributing to documentation, reviews, and mentoring juniors.


**Desired Profile**
* Looking for a DevSecOps \& AI Engineer with 4–7 years of hands‑on experience in cloud, DevOps, and AI/ML workflows.
* Strong skills in Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps).
* Proficient in Python and scripting (Bash/PowerShell) with good automation mindset.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices—SAST/DAST, container scanning, secrets scanning, SBOM, and policy\-as\-code.
* Exposure to MLOps/AI integration using MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Azure ML, KServe, or Seldon.
* Familiar with cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), configuration management (Ansible/Puppet), and GitOps tools (Argo CD/Flux).
* Strong communication, troubleshooting, and collaboration skills with ability to work cross‑functionally.


**Experience**
* 4 to 7 years


**Education**
* B.Tech. / BS in Computer Science


**Technical Skills \& Certifications**
* Terraform, Pulumi, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
* Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE), Docker/Podman, Helm, Kustomize
* CI/CD tools: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps
* Cloud platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP
* Python, Bash, PowerShell scripting
* DevSecOps tools: Snyk, SonarQube, Trivy, Checkmarx, GitLeaks, TruffleHog
* Policy\-as\-code (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno) and SBOM tools (Syft, CycloneDX)
* MLOps tools: MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Azure ML, Vertex AI
* Model serving frameworks: KServe, Seldon Core, BentoML, Ray Serve
* Vector DBs \& RAG stack: Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Chroma, LangChain, LlamaIndex
* Monitoring \& observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Loki, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger
* Configuration management: Ansible, Puppet
* GitOps: Argo CD, Flux
* Serverless: AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, Google Cloud Functions.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
